rules.sentinel_or_placeholder_value: numeric -99/-999/-9999/999/9999/99999 or text n/a|none|null|nan|unknown|tbd|placeholder|default|? in an identity / provenance column
rules.constant_column_where_variation_expected: a numeric value column (>= 100 values, not bool / version / line) holding ONE value on every row
rules.decimal_price_le_1: a decimal price column (odds / price / best_* / over / under) <= 1.0
rules.probability_outside_0_1: a probability column (p_* / *_prob* / implied* / fair_*) outside [0, 1]
rules.negative_count: a count column (goals, shots, corners, cards, books, rows, credits, minutes ...) < 0
rules.duplicate_key: a row repeating the key of an earlier row of the table (key = every identity / capture / run column present); its cells are not a distinct observation
rules.prematch_capture_after_kickoff: a pre-match table row whose capture time (snapshot_ts / captured_at / first_seen_ts / frozen_ts / generated_at / predicted_at / logged_at / ts_bet) is after its kickoff, or (any non-live table) a minutes_to_kickoff / minutes_close_before_kickoff / close_minutes_to_kickoff < 0
rules.flagged_wrong_by_own_columns: the row's own quality_flags carry a flag its source registers as WRONG (Pro src/quality.py)
rules.flagged_synthetic_default_fallback_imput: the row's own columns say synthetic / default / fallback / imputed / placeholder / degraded / no form (bool true, or the label in quality_flags / notes / source); its derived cells rest on substitutes
rules.no_provider_or_source_identity: no provider identity on the row: a price cell whose row names no real bookmaker (a provider feed without a book layer, e.g. API-Football /odds/live, counts its source), or a provider-table row without source / provider
rules.no_documented_derivation: a derived table no code (src / scripts / workflows) or README / docs of its repo names (no documented derivation)
